problem: The shape universally requires two non-magnetic heading means for every ship and contains no gross-tonnage condition, although the requirement applies only when gross_tonnage is at least 500.
required_change: Resolve the locked canonical gross-tonnage term and gate the heading-means obligations with gross_tonnage >= 500; ships below 500 must not be required to satisfy this shape's obligation. Locked resolution: use exactly https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#grossTonnage.
regression_guard: Preserve the target class nltl:ship while enforcing the 500-gross-tonnage applicability boundary.

problem: For each heading means node, sh:minCount 1 and sh:class only require some relation to a nonMagneticHeadingMeans node; they do not require the target to be another distinct means among the same ship's two-or-more heading means.
required_change: Add a topology constraint requiring each means to be independent from a distinct other non-magnetic heading means owned by the same ship, excluding self-links and unrelated external means.
regression_guard: Retain the per-means independence requirement while enforcing distinct-peer and same-ship topology.
